department: Department of Microbiology and Cell Biology

deadline.value: PhD applicants must have all materials in by December 15 for the following fall.
deadline.quote: PhD applicants, must have all materials submitted by December 15 for consideration for the following fall

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to biology, and the page does not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: Applicants without a faculty adviser can be admitted as rotation students each fall.
supervisor.quote: For those who do not secure a faculty advisor prior to applying for the PhD program, a few rotation students are accepted each fall.

funding.value: The department says all PhD students receive funding, with rotations funded by the department and then by advisers.
funding.quote: All PhD students receive funding, although exact amount and terms are unique to each student.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's is enough; a bachelor's outside biology, chemistry, physics, applied math or psychology is accepted with extra courses.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree in an area of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Applied Math or Psychology is recommended.

notes: The page lists PhD in Microbiology & Immunology and PhD in Biological Sciences from this department. A PhD/MS in Neuroscience is listed as not accepting applications, so no neuroscience record. Plant Genetics, Plant Pathology and Fish & Wildlife Biology PhDs were not researched.
name: Ph.D. in Biological Sciences and Ph.D. in Microbiology & Immunology
